name: Institute on Aging Friendship Line
description: Institute on Aging's Friendship Line is an accredited 24/7 toll-free emotional support and crisis line for Californians 60+, adults with disabilities, and caregivers, offering crisis intervention and friendly conversation.
fullDescription: Institute on Aging's Friendship Line is an accredited 24/7 toll-free emotional support and crisis line for Californians 60+, adults with disabilities, and caregivers, offering crisis intervention and friendly conversation.
whatTheyOffer:
- 24/7 emotional support and crisis intervention
- Suicide prevention
- Friendly conversation, plus regular check-in calls on request
- Grief support, including virtual bereavement groups
- Caregiver support
- Help in English, Spanish, Cantonese, Mandarin, Tagalog, Vietnamese, Korean, and Russian
howToGetIt: Call 888-670-1360 anytime (toll-free in California). No appointment or application. For regular outbound check-in calls, fill out the intake form online. Other languages - Spanish 888-571-0411, Cantonese/Mandarin 888-670-2504, Tagalog 888-570-0867, Vietnamese 888-670-1361, Korean 888-560-7684, Russian 888-560-7360.
keywords: Friendship Line, Institute on Aging, senior crisis, loneliness, isolation, companionship, grief support, caregivers, 60+
